description: This file implements URL handling functionalities within the WebSocket module of a C++ project, including URL parsing, encoding, decoding, and base64 operations.

classes.name: URL
classes.description: A class providing URL parsing, construction, and encoding/decoding functionalities within the WPEFramework namespace.

methods.name: URL::Encode
methods.description: Encodes a source string into a URL-encoded form, suitable for transmitting over HTTP.

methods.name: URL::Decode
methods.description: Decodes a URL-encoded string back to its original form.

methods.name: URL::Base64Encode
methods.description: Encodes binary data into a base64 string with optional padding.

methods.name: URL::Base64Decode
methods.description: Decodes a base64 string back into binary data.

methods.name: URL::Parse
methods.description: Parses a URL string into its components such as scheme, host, path, query, and ref.

methods.name: URL::ParseDomain
methods.description: Parses the domain component of a URL, extracting the host and port.

methods.name: URL::Text
methods.description: Constructs a URL string from its parsed components.
